Hi Kira — thanks for the list. Attached is the deliverable package we discussed:
- access_justification_matrix_v1.csv (RBAC mapping + owner & admin promotion workflow)
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (redacted examples)
- scim_delta_202508.zip (90-day delta export + readme)

Short least-privilege summary (for quick reference):
We enforce least-privilege by:
1) role templates default to read-only and require explicit ticketed exceptions for write/admin access;
2) role assignments via SCIM are scoped to service-specific groups with TTLs for temporary access;
3) admin promotions require a two-approver workflow (IAM owner + Security) and are audited automatically (events recorded to the audit log and retained 365 days).

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Audit-Pack-Cardinal (package files), HS-28943 (HubSpot request), DocuSign pack link included for any required attestations.

Let us know if you need the condensed SCIM->RBAC mapping; Rishi/Priyom can produce it within 24 hours.

Best — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
